holds.reason: 0.31.10 made its prompt renderer reject every prompt when stdin or stdout is not a TTY. The build's prompt runner (framework/cli/migrations, runDrizzleKitWithPrompts) answers drizzle-kit's create-vs-rename prompts over pipes, so on 0.31.10+ no migration can rename or replace a column and --migration-answers does nothing. 0.31.x has no non-interactive API: drizzle-kit/api's generateMigration calls the same prompting resolvers. The fix is drizzle-kit 1.0, whose generate takes --hints (and generateMigration(prev, cur, { hints })) instead of prompting, but it requires drizzle-orm >= 1.0, held below 0.39 (task-1793083762-bu58fd). Checked 2026-10-30 against 0.31.11 and 1.0.0-rc.5. Lift together with that move, replacing the prompt runner with hints. migrations-interactive.test.ts fails on any release that breaks prompt driving.
